hooks.text: 装备可与火、冰、雷、风元素融合，分别灼烧、减速、电击或吹飞敌人
hooks.excerpt: Equipment can also be merged with several elements, to create new and powerful versions. Burn monsters with fire, use ice to slow them down, shock them with thunder, or just get them off you using wind to blow them away!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 十五种职业各有明确优缺点，开局选职会实质改变整轮玩法
hooks.excerpt: You will unlock several classes with a variety of strengths and weaknesses. You can choose the class before starting the run and play in your preferred style! A total of 15 classes which have meaningfull impact on how you play!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 死亡会立即重开，但已解锁武器法术和获救角色会留下，玩家知识也跨轮积累
hooks.excerpt: There are no checkpoints in Dunjungle. You die, you start over. Die again, try again! But don't worry too much. Several things will remain for your next run. Maybe you unlocked a new weapon? Maybe a new spell? Maybe you saved a trapped character, who will now lend you a hand.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

excerpts.excerpt: 在像素肉鸽类游戏中体验可以称得上是优秀。
